mission.title: Viral Insertion
mission.description: Investigate the virus that is sending Anome's goons through the Effectuator's network lines.

npc.say: Traceroute... Access denied... Switch to silent mode... Port scan...
Hey, do you think your operator's okay? He sounded like he had a really bad headache or something. Probably stress.

phase.briefing:
Another day, another excuse from the inEffectuator. He's claiming that Anome is again doing something to hinder his progress in tracking Niobe.
I think he's just a big phony. He can't keep up this charade forever.

enter.say: Just thinking about what you have to do in there gave me an instant headache.

talk.say:
Five hops to the next address... Increased latency... Re-route through the sub-net... Hack the NAT...
Heyo, I'm a little occupied right now. Here, I'll spawn a sub-process for you. Talk to him.

What's on your mind, pally? Oh, right, the network problem!
Well, I know that hacker of Anome's, Maxson, got taken care of, but I think he's sicced someone else on me. What can I say, I'm a popular guy!
No, really though, this is serious. Here, go talk to serious me. You'll see.

done.say: "Serious me"? So he even refers to himself in the... What person is that?

talk.say:
{player}... I have a grave situation to report...
Anyway, some kind of new viral attack is sending Anome's goons right through phone and network lines! They're getting straight into my network centers this way. How can my technicians work when some big orange guy might pop out of their router at any time? I haven't been able to come up with an antivirus for it because I don't have enough data yet. I need you to hit the bricks and see what you can find. I'll send you to the last place they hacked.

done.say: Okay, I'm getting a location feed. Get out of there before more of him show up!

phase.briefing:
So, he flatters himself that Anome has dedicated another high-level hacker to foiling his pitiful networking attempts, does he? I'm not sure whether I should laugh or cry. Perhaps a little of both.
If you find something, try to wrap things up a little more quickly than with the last one, would you?

enter.say: I've got corrupt code readings in there... I'm reading some weird data on a phone line.

done.say: Data spike! You've got a bogey!
Nice... Let's see... Looks like they've hacked another line in there--a computer this time.

talk.say:
Ah! Let's see here... Yeah, here we go. Got a reading off those lunk-heads. Now, we just have to get them to pull that little stunt of theirs at another of my computer centers that they've invaded, I'll be able to track them back to their source.
Ready for another go? I'll get the coordinates to your operator.

phase.briefing: And there you go traipsing off to another of the imbecile's computer centers... This had better be going somewhere...

enter.say: There's a mainframe in there; looks like it's been compromised. This could get ugly...

done.say: Yow! That opened the floodgate! They're all over the place!
I just got a call from you-know-who. He says he got a trace on their origin. He's sending me the coordinates now.

phase.briefing: At least you're going somewhere other than one of his own facilities for once. I expect results, {player}...

enter.say: Code corruption all over that place.

done.say: Jackpot! Phenora--could that be the name of this latest hacker? Get that data, {player}!
You're gonna have to upload that to me from a hardline.

objective.text: Upload the Data at a hardline

mission.finish:
A name and data on a diabolical plan against our customers, eh? I suppose you've done something useful for once--maybe. We'll have to see if Phenora manifests herself at one of these locations.
Oh, I suppose you ought to know--certain sources tell us that those who've used one of Anome's "cheat code" vials gain massive power, but can no longer jack out of the simulation. Maxson was probably one of those; Phenora could be another.
